mutants.name: acceptance-narrowed
mutants.why: narrowing the acceptance back to BAR_MET-only means CONTINUE is refused; a folding walk returns CONTINUE and l14 expects exit 0

mutants.name: acceptance-widened
mutants.why: accepting any last line means even ESCALATE:assert-fail passes the gate; l15 expects exit 1 on that escalation

mutants.name: warn-echo-removed
mutants.why: removing the WARN echo means downgrade lines from cycle_check are silently swallowed; l16 expects the LENS-COMMIT: cycle WARN — … line
